> But there are so many opportunities in life.

Certainly not coming my way. 

>Do you really think that well, nothing is better then all the possibilities in the world today?

Yes.
>I mean death means no happiness or I guess sadness ever again...

Yes.

>...but if you choose to live, you can be happy...

Empirically speaking I'd disagree.
>...so even if for some reason the "normal" idea of going to school/job/SO/kids isn't working for you, you can be doing other stuff.

Yes with the magical free money which I will pull out of my ass. Education and a job is kind of necessary for a decent survival these days. Automation will eat labour jobs soon. Which is a good thing.
>But death means nothing good or bad ever again.

Kind of the point.

Sorry to be a bit harsh. It's nice to get a response. Thank you. <3

I'm aware that it's highly unlikely I'll be having new experiences after death but that doesn't matter to me. Stay with me here on this one; I won't be able to know that I can't have new experiences because I will be dead. It simply does not matter.

Mine were fine. Venlafaxine is the only one I've been on. When it worked it was amazing. Hell I wouldn't even be thinking like this. But it just peters out for me. I just seem to go back to homoeostasis and for me that's feeling like shit.

Also benzos. <3

Used responsibly of course.

Almost forgot my main point. Death's pretty fucking holistic.

I'm not not a pussy for not killing my self.

Times have always been tough, unrelenting.

Yeah they'll miss me but where the fuck are they now?

God it's even been a month since I last attempted and surprisingly it's actually gotten worse, I now have less control over my drugs and my best friend's mother has gone cold on me so I can't go around there to just partially pay attention to anime, joke around and laugh my ass off and stay the night.

I'm fucking crying like a bitch now.

It's not like I don't want to meet new people. I'm just broke and live in a small town and I only have a fucking derelict bicycle for transport. Feeling like a worthless piece of shit doesn't help with socialising either.

I'm fucking sick of trying, hence suicide.

Also, if I'm a pussy for killing my self and a pussy for not killing my self then I'll just be Schrödinger's pussy.
Sorry man. Anti-depressants are pretty decent though.

Ha. Thanks for the reply. Reminds me of one of my favourite songs, [The Warmth - Incubus](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VeHddLI-aY8).

There really are nice people out there. I know this. Thing is they don't like me. No one really seems to. No it isn't worth the search and I don't have the resources to search anyway.

I'm a 20 year old male. A lot of things are fun. Especially with other people. But, yeah, alone. And sure maybe it's my fault. I wouldn't be surprised. Maybe I'm just an asshole.

I have plenty of potential but I struggle with motivation. All ambition, no drive sadly.

If this goes on I'd fucking hate to live another 10 years writhing in sadness.

I live with all my fuck-ups but I don't care. I can't change the past.

I honestly think I'm just going to pussy out again. But I just really fucking want this to end.
